{{Quote|Metameur. We just wanted to take a look at the freighter landing pad there.|Biggs Darklighter|<ref name="LCOT" />}}
'''Metameur''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], located somewhere near the [[Desolation Canyons]] and a long way from the [[Douz outpost]]. It was important enough to possess its own landing platform for [[Freighter/Legends|cargo ships]].<ref name="LCOT" />

In [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Biggs Darklighter/Legends|Biggs Darklighter]] intended to visit Metameur in hopes of seeing a docked [[Starship/Legends|spaceship]], but they were caught in a [[Sandstorm/Legends|sandstorm]] while passing through the [[Desolation Canyons]].<ref name="LCOT" />
